fixes.explanation: Learning on their own isn't in the verse. Solomon says everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD, and he adds, "be assured that he will not go unpunished" (Proverbs 16:5). Nothing there about the proud figuring it out themselves. The verse says they will not go unpunished.

That's the word. A man's heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps (Proverbs 16:9). The heart draws the map and the LORD determines the steps. I never planned on a cookie planet, friend, and yet here I am on a gold base with a mustache full of flour.

Strength isn't what the verse gives the fool. Solomon says the discipline of fools is folly (Proverbs 16:22). A fool can work hard at it, but hard work doesn't turn folly into anything else. Understanding is the one that is a fountain of life to its possessor.
